title: Easily Add Thermal Testing to Industrial PCB Manufacturing Processes
summary: PCB Thermal Testing: Easily add thermal testing capabilities to your printed circuit board manufacturing process to ensure product reliability and increase throughput. ThermoStream temperature test solutions, bring temperature to your production line.
body_markdown:
## The Problem:


Product reliability challenges over the specified thermal range of your printed circuit boards (PCBs).


## The Solution:


Thermal testing with a portable ThermoStream


The supply chain for electronic components has been in a state of uncertainty for several years. Obsolescence, long lead times, and high prices have lead R and D teams to have to continuously source alternative components.


Just because a sourced component has the same spec, does not mean that it will work the same when it is integrated into a PCB.


To ensure the reliability of your products over their operating temperature range, thermal testing is required.


Read more in the[PCB Thermal Testing](https://www.intestthermal.com/applications/pcb-thermal-testing)


[Application Note](https://www.intestthermal.com/applications/pcb-thermal-testing)


to see how easily thermal testing can be integrated into your PCB production line to reduce failures and increase product reliability.
